text: Only in 1873 did Tokyo convert the chronicle's date to our calendar and make the eleventh of February a holiday, abolished after the war and restored in 1966.
spoken: Only in eighteen seventy-three did Tokyo convert the chronicle's date to our calendar and make the eleventh of February a holiday, abolished after the war and restored in nineteen sixty-six.
